featured_reviews.name: Sunny Gurnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was wanting to try this home made meal from a long time and finally could manage to try it last night. The team is very courteous and eager to ensure a pleasant food experience. The meal which is priced quite economically at 120rs inclusive of home delivery charges comes in plastic containers and rotis in safe and nice packing. The meal had a portion of white rice which were of good quality which is hard to find such tiffin services, a container portion of dal which was plain with mild tadka and just the kind you would expect at home that suits all taste buds, rotis were typical sindhi style that is very soft with a touch of oil and last was the paneer capsicum which was mildly dry and had onion in it too.

Overall the meal was pretty good and so was the service. I will be giving it a few more try soon again to experience more items.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Thiagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across Sunita's Tiffin Services while looking for a good, home cooked meal delivery service that can deliver meals in and around Chembur, Kurla East, Chunabhatti. I was looking for home cooked meals for dinner as I wanted to avoid the hassle of making meals post 9 P.M. or eating random food from hotels.

I've been availing their services since June 2024 and am a delighted customer.

They have meals labelled regular (large portions) and mini (standard portions). The meals come with a Sabzi, a Dal, Rotis and Rice. You can get extra Rotis instead of the rice or vice versa as they are open to customising. Their food is home made, light on the stomach, and tastes wonderful. The team juggles their sabzis and dals everyday offering the consumer lots of variety.

They deliver lunch and dinner at the doorstep with the help of a great group of delivery personnel.

I can't praise them enough. Great food, great service and a delight!

So I will suggest for lunch any can continue for long time . So Ami's Kitchen is best of best.

featured_reviews.name: Rupal Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been subscribed to Ami’s kitchen tiffin since 2 years now and it has been amazing. The quantity and quality is very good. Home cooked food at its best ! Would really recommend to all who are busy individuals and miss home cooked food 👌

featured_reviews.name: Akanksha Rohhri
featured_reviews.review_text: The Food was too good and great. The food was delicious and well-prepared. The highlight for me was the amras – it was absolutely amazing, perfectly sweet, fresh, and full of flavor. Definitely one of the best I’ve had. Overall, a satisfying meal and simply tasty. Every item was nice it was for 30 people lunch every thing was nice.

featured_reviews.name: Kushal Haria
featured_reviews.review_text: Group order for 10 pax. The food was very tasty and well made. Smooth communication and good suggestions for setting our menu. Hassle free delivery experience. I will definitely be ordering again.

You can really feel the love and effort put into every meal. It feels like there is magic in her hands because everything tastes so perfect. Highly recommended!”

featured_reviews.name: Annoda Vinod
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered from lunch from Heroti for around 7 months when we were new to the place and were setting up our home. The food was really delicious, homemade and was sufficient for 2 people. The delivery service was on time and never missed a single delivery. They have very flexible plans and are very accommodating when it comes to adjusting the dates of any meals. I would recommend their service to anyone who is looking for a healthy homely tasty meal.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Priyadarshi
featured_reviews.review_text: The best home made food that you can find in Mumbai and that too home delivered. The variety offered is simply amazing. As promised, no dish was repeated and each one of them was superb. People like us who have a hectic schedule and can't cook or order food every now and then, it is a life saver. The staff is very polite and courteous. Saw all necessary precautions taken during delivery. The food is neatly packed and is still warm after delivery. If you are missing home made food then this is the place. And it is very budget friendly.

featured_reviews.name: Prasant Tripathy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall service from Heroti very well justifies it's tagline.
Food tastes very good and same like home cooked food.Their on time delivery is a plus point.
Rates are very reasonable and having tried lots of other similar services in the market,I don't think so anyone is providing this kind of quality food at such rates with on time home delivery.
Please keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Delicious home-cooked meals that are not only tasty but also impeccably hygienic. The best part is that they are delivered fresh right to my doorstep with a warm and friendly smile. I highly recommend this service to anyone looking for a convenient and healthy meal option that doesn't compromise on flavor.

featured_reviews.name: Arpit Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text: My father is in Quarantine center and we are home quarantined so I requested these guys to supply lunch and dinner to my dad, they agreed and started delivery from the same day. The food they are providing is delicious and has very good quantity also. They are Hero's for our family - great people providing Great quality food. Keep it up guys.

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Kale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great home made food in your locality. The food is delicious and best suited for almost everyone in the family. I haven't found such food quality and on time delivery in Borivali atleast.
You can have a 3 day trail and then decide as well.
Thumbs up Heroti 👍.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Chandrashekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very good food and excellent service at reasonable prices, always enusred timely delivery of tiffins. No repeats of dal and vegetables in lunch and dinner over a week which is excellent in itself. More than adequate quantity of food in a meal.

They supported during our quarantine when my entire family had tested positive and no one was available to cook.
Very courteous and helpful people overall who strive to achieve customer satisfaction as thier priority.
